translate_en|mods/ConeVisionOutline/42/m: Cone Vision Outline
Cone outline intensity
Outline opacity, 0 to 1 (default 0.3). Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name.
Enforce these settings for all players

Multiplayer only. Off by default: every player uses their own Cone Vision Outline options (Settings -> Mods). When on, the settings below replace each player's own, and changing them in the mod options has no effect. The outline colour stays the player's choice. Has no effect in singleplayer.
Legacy outline mode

Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: use the old square-visibility check instead of asking the game which zombies and animals it draws.
Outlines always on
Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: outlines are shown all the time, not only while aiming (RMB).
Outline animals
Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: animals are outlined along with zombies.
Scale outline by fog
Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: outlines fade with distance in fog.
Scale outline by light level

Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: the outline fades as the light on the target drops, and is gone in full darkness. Turn this on to stop outlines giving away zombies in the dark.
Vehicle: outlines always on
Applied only when 'Enforce these settings for all players' is on. Same as the mod option of the same name: in a vehicle, outlines are shown without holding RMB.
Cone outline intensity
Outline opacity (0 — barely visible, 1 — full brightness). Same idea as View Cone Opacity in game options.
Cone outline color
Color of the outline for zombies and animals in the vision cone when aiming (RMB). Melee hit-list green outline is unchanged.
Legacy outline mode

Off by default. The mod now asks the game which zombies and animals it has already decided to draw, instead of guessing from square visibility and the mod's own vision-cone math. Turn this on to go back to the old guesswork if the new default ever looks wrong to you.
Outlines always on

Off by default. When on, outlines are shown all the time, whether you are aiming (RMB) or not, on foot or in a vehicle. Overrides the vehicle-only option below, which still works fine on its own if you leave this off.
Outline animals
When on, animals in the vision cone are outlined along with zombies. When off, only zombies are outlined. On by default.
Scale outline by fog

Off by default. The game doesn't track fog per tile, only one thickness for the whole world at a time, so this approximates it: outlines fade toward the edge of your current clear-visibility radius (the same one the game itself uses), scaled by how thick the fog is right now. Has no effect at all outside of fog. Combines with 'Scale outline by light level' when both are on, and the cone outline intensity slider is the ceiling for the result. Works in both Legacy and the new default outline mode. Rarely, on certain scene geometry (thin posts/beams), an outline scaled by this or by light level can render behind that object instead of through it -- a limitation of the game's own renderer.
Scale outline by light level

Off by default. When on, the outline fades as the light on the target drops (darker = fainter, full dark = no outline). It reads the same light the game uses to draw the zombie itself, so your flashlight, lamps and fire all count, not just the ambient sky. The cone outline intensity slider is the ceiling: the outline holds that opacity in good light and only fades below it. Works in both Legacy and the new default outline mode. Rarely, on certain scene geometry (thin posts/beams), an outline scaled by this or by fog can render behind that object instead of through it -- a limitation of the game's own renderer.
Cone Vision Outline
Vehicle: outlines always on
When on, in a vehicle outlines are shown without holding RMB (aim/look). When off, same as vanilla: hold RMB to see outlines.
